Summarize the following paragraph in 2 sentences:
Rising sea levels are reshaping coastlines faster than most cities can adapt. Over the past three decades, global mean sea level has risen by roughly 9 centimeters, and the rate is accelerating as polar ice sheets lose mass. Coastal metropolises such as Jakarta, Miami, and Shanghai now face routine tidal flooding that was once reserved for extreme storms. Adaptation measures vary widely: some cities invest in sea walls and storm surge barriers, others restore wetlands and mangroves as natural buffers, and a few are beginning to plan managed retreat from the most vulnerable districts. The cost of inaction is no longer theoretical, since insurance premiums in affected areas are climbing and property values are starting to reflect flood risk. Experts argue that a mix of hard infrastructure, nature-based solutions, and stricter land-use policy is needed, but political will and funding remain the binding constraints.

Rewrite the following technical paragraph in simpler language:
Inference latency is dominated by memory-bound operators during the decode phase, because the model must read the full weight matrix on every step while computing only a small number of activations. Batching multiple requests amortizes these reads across a larger activation matrix, which raises arithmetic intensity and improves hardware utilization, but it also increases time-to-first-token for the later requests in the batch.
